title: Create Durable Prompt Compile Queue Schema
description: Add durable `prompt_compile_jobs` table and indexes with job status lifecycle, retry metadata, idempotency key uniqueness, and audit timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Given migration run, when schema is applied, then durable compile queue table exists with required status and retry fields.
Given enqueue attempts with same idempotency key, when insert/upsert occurs, then only one effective active job exists.
Given queue table usage, when queried, then operational metrics fields (attempts, next attempt, last error) are available.
Given migration idempotency, when rerun, then schema remains consistent with no duplicate artifacts.
